def is_bold_red(font):
    """Return True for the manually highlighted bold-red rich-text runs."""
    if font is None:
        return False

    bold = bool(getattr(font, "b", False) or getattr(font, "bold", False))
    if not bold:
        return False

    color = getattr(font, "color", None)

        return False

    rgb = getattr(color, "rgb", None)

    """Yield (text, font) from either a plain string or CellRichText."""
    if value is None:
        return
    if isinstance(value, str):
        yield value, None
        return

        for part in value:

                yield part.text, part.font
            else:
                yield str(part), None

    for pat in patterns:
        pieces = [re.escape(p) for p in pat.split()]
        body = r"\s+".join(pieces)

        prefix = r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])" if pat[0].isalnum() else ""
        suffix = r"(?![A-Za-z0-9])" if pat[-1].isalnum() else ""
        regex_parts.append(f"{prefix}(?:{body}){suffix}")

    combined_re = re.compile("|".join(regex_parts), re.IGNORECASE)

    # Bold red rich-text font used for every located pattern.

        rFont="Calibri",
        sz=11,
        b=True,
        color="FFFF0000"
    )
